notes.title: #10: The New Year brings a Combat Update
notes.content:
[i]"I woke up in terror from a horrible nightmare. I stepped outside to compose myself and realized… everyone in the village had woken up. Everyone." -- Baon, Village Merchant[/i]

[h3]Finally an update. It was about time![/h3]
He nodded as a flurry of regrets flooded his-

[h3]No! Stop typing novels. Just describe the progress in two words![/h3]
I see. If I had to narrow it down to two words, they would be "making combat satisfying".

[h3]Great math skill! ːsteamfacepalmː Tell me more about the combat.[/h3]
Combat is an integral part of the game, more so than most metroidvanias. We want to go beyond the sporadic encounters with singular enemies that you destroy as you traverse. Not to say this isn't going to happen, but we have a vision!!! The combat is to be [b]HECTIC[/b], exciting and [b]FUN[/b]. Quite the visionary developers, right?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/e001dd2f7324813ce82ba7deffac196c55f3f652.jpg[/img]

To that end we built a combat prototype, to rapidly test ideas for enemies, abilities, items etc. We've already implemented several things. 
[list]
[*]A juicing update to make hits more satisfying. 
[*]Overwhelming enemies that soft lock areas. 
[*]A combat flow that goes beyond the simple hit-dash-hit.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/f112480cae36d26467e6004b7dc454c9983a2eb3.gif[/img]

We're not [b]fully [/b]there yet, but combat is certainly [b]a LOT more fun[/b] than what it was.

See you next time!

John K, [strike]Novelist[/strike] Game Designer

Overwhelming enemies that soft lock areas.
A combat flow that goes beyond the simple hit-dash-hit.

notes.title: Apocalypse #9: Merry Hero and a Happy New Year!
notes.content:
He was pacing up and down a dark room, the only light coming from a computer monitor. On it, a blinking cursor felt like a ticking [b]clock[/b]. Judge and jury. [b]He knew he had messed up. [/b]

[i]“How did this happen?”[/i] he thought. [i]“When did time disappear?”[/i]. 

Outside they were celebrating the turn of the year but he was restless. He could feel the coming storm... three months without an update. [u]He was the worst[/u].

He inhaled deeply and started typing... let's appease the gods. Let's reveal the new hero.

[h2]Finally an update. What happened to the old hero?[/h2]

He thought of Penny, the very human girl. How out of place she felt in the new, magical universe that was being magically created with code and electricity.


[h2]Are you referring to yourself in the third person?[/h2]

He nodded as his face darkened for dramatic effect... the first attempts at updating her design failed. Miserably.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/d0198cc45cc9c5cb38976ff7dfe5d8974ff07715.png[/img]

[h2]Yeah these look not good. What happened next?[/h2]

It was a time of despair and sorrow. Trying to save the animation work was a shackle that had to be cast aside. And cast it aside, they eventually did.

When that happened, everything changed. The face of a new hero shined through. A hero both fragile and strong, a hero destined to fight legends. He got goosebumps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/7a2f54f6ceb1740e5e9f5bb65575b5da2f5723ec.jpg[/img]


Everything started moving faster now. Finetuning the details, sculpting the model, these were but droplets in the river of time, rushing towards the inevitable conclusion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/c3ea7aa1fbb4f965b54cfaf065ff385cf9ef65c1.png[/img]


A hero had been born. They cried tears of joy as the screenshots instantly improved by its presence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/2af75d2b266e2dc30b5acdaf5e36bd62a9177ca1.jpg[/img]

And then, they saw him coming alive. An arsenal of movements that's constantly expanding as a torrent of abilities and events get added in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/45cdf54fb44bd921ab819b07f25a055c10d96cd8.gif[/img]
[i]basic idle animation[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/7be60f6538ab41a89cad96cf72bda9a89e3dff34.gif[/img]
[i]run animation for a chase sequence[/i]


"That's our (still) unnamed hero! I hope you like the design" he shouted to the void and logged off. See you soon (-er than last time).

-- John K, Novel Writer


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31211805/995c410463a961124a9c67aa0a5da1297ab5cdd0.png[/img]

notes.title: Apocalypse Cow News #3: Animations
notes.content:
[i]Hello incredible fan! Here's another update for you - proof that we're busy working and not vacating somewhere tropical. Because who cares about Fiji when you can develop games in a basement![/i]

[h1]Okay, okay - what have you clowns been up to?[/h1]
Lots of stuff. Like, all of them. All teh stuff!
[list]
[*] Creating and updating characters.[*]  Reworking all of them animations. [*] Extending the lore and the story, ironing out any wrinkles still there. [*] Testing out bigger maps with optional exploration.
[/list]

[h1]Wait - why rework the animations?[/h1]
Alex (our animator, known as Animator Alex) always wanted 3d models in his workflow. He claimed he'd do a better job with them or something, I don't know - I kind of phase him out when he's saying things. <3

With the new story we had to redesign many characters and that's when he chose to strike - sneaky bastard. He created this sample to convince us to redesign them in 3D.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31211805/709cc16f5d55eca875a6f2e9c4043f5003ed82dd.gif[/img]

As you can tell, it looks much better so I caved and greenlit it. It's also going to really improve our cutscenes and ultimately tell the story in a better way. Yeay!

[h1]What about the bigger maps?[/h1]
You've probably noticed: I can't shut up about our new story. [b]The lore we wrote is extensive[/b], allowing us to build wonderful worlds for you to explore. But up to now the game was linear.

Now the worlds are more open. The path forward is still fairly obvious so you can play in a linear fashion if you're in a hurry. But you can also [b]choose to explore, see more of the world and learn more of its history[/b]. It's up to you! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Nice! When is it coming out?[/h1]
And that's all the time we had for today. See you next time! *runs away in terror.

notes.title: Status Update #1: Story is Dan
notes.content:
[i]The night was brighter than usual. The clock struck midnight and the crowd erupted. Amidst the celebrations for this glorious new year, a pale creature known as game developer stood apart. Hand on his keyboard, he whispered: "I swear to write more blog posts this year!".[/i]

So here I am, with the first update of 2019!!

[h1]Uhm… amusing. So? What's up?[/h1]

We recently hit a very important milestone. The story is 100% done!!!

I don't want to give out any spoilers but it is [b]an epic storyline that plays out through several years![/b] (drools).

In the process of creating the story we wrote lore going back millennia (which we might release as a short story or comic before launch), we designed many new characters and even [b]created a written and spoken language[/b], complete with phonology and grammar rules! I went a little insane there but I did it on my free time, I promise.

[h1]Wow, you nerded out hard. So, what are you up to now?[/h1]

These days Alex is trying out ideas for the various new weapons, boss fights and abilities that we're adding to the game. Elias is working on optimizing performance and I am writing the script/dialogues for our voice actors.

We're also bringing in a great concept artist to enrich the worlds with the lore, for that sweet environmental storytelling.

[h1]Cool! But can you show me something? Anything!?![/h1]

Well… here is a random image with some of our weapons! Most of them are references, can you spot them?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31211805/64649709c8a1ca7e830989f1d1989edbb55fbcd1.jpg[/img]

Thanks for your continued support, you have the best taste in games!!! Until next time!!! ːsteamhappyː

tags.feature: created a written and spoken language

notes.title: Expanding the Game
notes.content:
You might be wondering what's going on.

Despite popular belief, we are not at the Bahamas drinking [strike]Cosmopolitan[/strike] manly beers. We weren't abducted by aliens (although that would REALLY help our PR efforts). We're still working on Apocalypse Cow full time, pedal to the floor.

[h1]So why isn't it out yet? Are you sloths?[/h1]

The simple answer is, in a moment of complete craziness we decided to follow an amazing idea and started a complete story rewrite.

We are turning Apocalypse Cow into a very gripping storytelling experience, honestly one of the best storytelling Hollywood has to offer!

And it's been time consuming...

We paused all marketing communications until we finalize the narrative, because everything is tied to it. Graphics, weapons, gameplay, everything.

This marketing pause obviously hurts us but I really do hope that the end result will make up for our decision.

One thing is certain: [b]the game is now so much more and I'm terribly proud of it. [/b]

[h1]Keep talking... what are you adding?[/h1]

Crazy things happen in the new story - you will laugh, you will cry, you will high five yourself. It will consume and immerse you until you are reduced to two wide-open eyeballs soaking it all in. 

Or you can press the skip button, but somewhere in the world a baby zebra will die.

This expanded scope brought in more weapons and abilities, new unique enemies that need specific strategies to fight, additional bosses, worlds that feel alive and a few other surprises. 

We honestly don't know how long the game is now. It used to be a 5-6 hour experience, now it's probably double the size. We'll clock it when it's done.

[h1]Fine, stop talking - what do you want from me?[/h1]

[b]Keep believing in this game. It's going to be something special.[/b] If you have any questions don't hesitate to ask.

notes.title: Feature Highlight: Costumes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31211805/88b0ba0d7e0b934ccd156f931c3cceb76d9db967.jpg[/img]

Hi GameWalker!

We can't deny it. Penny is a little crazy. She's a short tempered badass that will smoke your butt if you look at her funny. But that's not all that defines her! When she doesn't rain terror and destruction, her favorite passtime is cosplaying!

[h1]Cosplay in Apocalypse Cow[/h1]
During a mission if you come by one of the various Cosplay Phonebooths don't think twice. Get in there and, in the blink of an eye, she'll be sporting one of her many rad costumes, like a new Superman!

Here's one of them. [b]Guess who she's cosplaying as!![/b]
Need a hint? [spoiler]Her full name grows longer with every season![/spoiler]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31211805/6c58220b651440682410c0053bae5fdb7f87933e.png[/img]

[h1]Collect Coins to Unlock[/h1]
While using a cosplay booth is temporary, you can use the coins you pick up from killing baddies to unlock a costume permanently. Gotta get them all!

[h1]Costumes in Co-op[/h1]
Of course when you play co-op, Penny's imaginary friend isn't left hanging! The Kid gets a matching costume too! Because everything is better with a friend! But more on that on next month's feature highlight.

See you next time GameWalkers and remember, if you kinda like the game, let the world know!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31211805/c2d367893e51abc5fce5453f6499e600ce6b917a.jpg[/img]
